race.comment: SOVIET STORM (2) has the clearest race form and earns top billing after finishing fourth at Canberra last start, beaten just over a length, despite interference around the home turn. He had also been solid at Bathurst the run prior and is rated strongly across the recent measures, so this looks a suitable maiden for him to break through. TEEMING (5) is harder to line up on debut, but first-time blinkers and the Joe Cleary debut figures give him genuine upside. ALLUSIVE SHADOW (6) needs to improve sharply on recent outings, but this is a fairly weak race, so be default, she's the next in line. Debutant REBEL STAR (4) next best.
